messages:
nina: Heads-up — opened a docs PR for the Python migration guide and SDK snippet fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428

sam: thanks! can you call out which snippets changed? I want to check for voice/terminology regressions

nina: main changes: 1) replace "model version" with "model variant" where it refers to inference variant, 2) update Python snippet to use `Client` async context, 3) fix broken link to embed'ing guide

alyssa: will review for tone tomorrow morning. prefer present-tense, active voice — e.g., "use" not "you should use" :+1:

marco: CI docs preview is still queued — deploy-bot shows preview URL when it's done.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build queued for PR #428. ETA ~12m. https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-428

lisa: quick nit — examples shouldn't show raw API keys inline. replace with `os.environ["REDWOOD_API_KEY"]` pattern

nina: thanks @lisa, updated. Also added a short migration table summarizing breaking changes.

sam: assigning reviewers: @alyssa + @marco. Merge window preference: today before 18:00 PT if CI green, otherwise can wait for tomorrow morning.

alyssa: I'll do a pass focused on terminology and examples. If I see multiple places where "model version" is ambiguous I'll leave inline comments.

marco: I'll validate the SDK snippet runs locally and check the async pattern. If CI fails because of preview build glitch, ping me in #eng-devex.

nina: style question: is it ok to use 'we' voice for guidance sections? or should docs stay neutral.

alyssa: short answer: we prefer "we" for higher-level conceptual explanations, but how-to steps should be imperative ("Run", "Set up"). Add a note in the style guide if unclear.

nina: will add a one-line in the style doc and reference it in the PR.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build complete — preview available: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-428/overview

marco: preview looks good, but failing lint: "terminology/consistent-model-term" at sdk_snippets/python.md:12

nina: fixed that commit 1903456801

ci-bot: docs-lint: all checks passed

alyssa: LGTM aside from one phrasing nit on the migration table header.

nina: pushed header tweak. can anyone merge after CI green? I don't have merge perms for protected branch.

sam: I'll merge once both LGTM and CI green and we're inside the merge window. tagging @eng-release for awareness.

marco: merged at 1903456850 :shipit:

nina: thanks everyone :heart:
